Santhali Voice Clarity: A/B Comparison

Direct auditory comparison: Baseline (Unfiltered / Rushed) vs. Pedagogical Enhanced (Filtered & Paced)

1. Cooperative Learning

Grade 1-3 Social
आज हम सब मिलकर एक नया खेल खेलेंगे।
ᱛᱮᱦᱮᱧ ᱵᱚ ᱥᱟᱱᱟᱢ ᱠᱚ ᱢᱮᱥᱟ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱢᱤᱫᱴᱟᱝ ᱱᱟᱣᱟ ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱟᱵᱚ
🔴 Baseline (Previous)
Standard scales (length=1.0, noise=0.67). Notice background hiss and rushed tempo (3.36s).
🟢 Pedagogical Enhanced (New)
Tuned tempo (length=1.26, noise=0.45) + 85Hz HPF + Consonant Boost (4.08s). Crisper vowels & clean silence.

2. Incentive & Praise

FLN Motivation
जो बच्चा सबसे पहले उत्तर देगा उसे शाबाशी मिलेगी।
ᱜᱤᱫᱽᱨᱟᱹ ᱫᱚ ᱯᱳᱭᱞᱳ ᱥᱟᱨᱦᱟᱣᱮ ᱧᱟᱢᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱩᱛᱛᱚᱨᱮ ᱮᱢᱟ
🔴 Baseline (Previous)
Uncalibrated stochastic duration with audible room reverb.
🟢 Pedagogical Enhanced (New)
Smooth vocal envelope, stable phoneme timing, zero low-end rumble.

🔴 Baseline (Previous)

4. Directions & Science (Compound Sentence)

Complex Clause Pacing
सूरज पूर्व दिशा से उगता है और शाम को पश्चिम में ढलता है।
ᱥᱤᱸᱜᱟᱹᱲ ᱨᱮ ᱯᱚᱪᱷᱤᱢ ᱥᱮᱫ ᱛᱮ ᱨᱟᱠᱟᱵᱚᱜᱼᱟ ᱟᱨ ᱯᱩᱨᱩᱵ ᱥᱮᱫ ᱛᱮ ᱟᱲᱩᱜᱟ
🔴 Baseline (Previous)
Rushed single block without breath pause at conjunction 'ᱟᱨ'.
🟢 Pedagogical Enhanced (New)
Automatic breath pause inserted before 'ᱟᱨ'. Two balanced clauses with clear phrasing.
